codes.means: two records carry the same context id
codes.fix: give each record its own id

codes.means: the evidence source changed since it was pinned
codes.fix: recheck the claim and verify the record again

codes.means: as_of is later than the date the check was run for
codes.fix: set as_of to the date it was actually verified

codes.means: as_of, or an evidence item's date, is not a real calendar date
codes.fix: write a real date as YYYY-MM-DD

codes.means: the evidence or relations key is not a JSON list of objects
codes.fix: rewrite it as a JSON list of objects

codes.means: an evidence item's type is not decision, reversal, constraint or claim
codes.fix: set its type to one of those

codes.means: an evidence item's origin is not human, agent or capture
codes.fix: set its origin to one of those

codes.means: keep is not keep, home or share
codes.fix: set keep to keep, home or share

codes.means: the record could not be read into the context graph
codes.fix: fix the header the finding names

codes.means: a relation has no type or no target
codes.fix: give every relation a type and a target

codes.means: the record has no context_version, so it carries no verification, sharing or evidence contract
codes.fix: declare context_version 1 and its required keys

codes.means: a ## Next action section exists and next_actor is empty
codes.fix: set next_actor to who takes the next action

codes.means: an evidence item does not name who supplied it
codes.fix: set its by

codes.means: context version 1 requires id, summary, read_when, as_of, keep and audience; one is empty
codes.fix: set the key the finding names

codes.means: an evidence item names no source, or a local source that does not exist
codes.fix: point its source at a file or URL that exists

codes.means: a relation has no target, or names one no record has
codes.fix: point the relation at an existing record's id or path

codes.means: the record's frontmatter block does not parse, so nothing in its header can be read
codes.fix: fix the header block; the finding names the line

codes.means: a typed **Operators:** line disagrees with the operators the People roles derive
codes.fix: delete the Operators line; it is derived from People

codes.means: the record declares no owner (ok: it declares one, linked and listed under People)
codes.fix: set owner to a person slug and list them under ## People with the owner role

codes.means: the owner does not resolve to a person record (warn: named as bare text rather than a slug or link)
codes.fix: set owner to a slug that has a record in people/, or fix the link

codes.means: the owner is not on the ## People list
codes.fix: add them to ## People with the owner role

codes.means: the parent chain comes back to this superproject
codes.fix: break the cycle: one of these is not a subproject of the next

codes.means: the folder sits inside another superproject and its parent key names no parent, or a different one
codes.fix: set parent to the enclosing superproject's folder name, or move the folder

codes.means: the parent names no superproject folder, live or done
codes.fix: set parent to an existing superproject's folder name, or remove it

codes.means: a subproject sits beside its parent rather than inside the parent's superprojects/ folder
codes.fix: superprojects nest-plan lists the move; the product moves it and relinks

codes.means: the record names itself as its parent
codes.fix: remove parent, or set it to the superproject this one serves

codes.means: the record has no ## People list
codes.fix: add one, owner first

codes.means: a person under ## People links to a record that does not exist (warn: is bare text rather than a link)
codes.fix: link them to their record in people/, or create it

codes.means: a person under ## People has no role from the vocabulary
codes.fix: rewrite the line as - [Name](link) — <role>: how they are involved

codes.means: the header block and the People list give a person different roles
codes.fix: make the two agree; roles are the source

codes.means: a person has a role in the header block and no line under ## People
codes.fix: add their People line with the link and how they are involved

codes.means: the record declares no source of truth (ok: it declares one that agrees with its repository)
codes.fix: set source_of_truth to org/repo

codes.means: the declared source of truth differs from the remote of the repository the record sits in
codes.fix: fix whichever is stale, or move the record

codes.means: more than one person is tagged owner; exactly one is answerable
codes.fix: make the others co-lead

codes.means: a finite superproject has no ATOMIC-ACTION-MAP.md
codes.fix: draft its atomic action map backwards from the deliverable

codes.means: the folder holds both SUPERPROJECT.md and the legacy PROJECT.md; only SUPERPROJECT.md is read
codes.fix: merge anything PROJECT.md still says into SUPERPROJECT.md, then delete PROJECT.md

codes.means: the file names no standard, the unversioned URL of its kind (written before standards had versions), or another kind's standard
codes.fix: superprojects migrate --root superprojects --stamp-standard --apply

codes.means: the file names a version of its standard that this version of @supersuit/superprojects does not implement
codes.fix: upgrade @supersuit/superprojects to a version that implements it; never stamp a newer record back

codes.means: as_of is earlier than the date the check was run for
codes.fix: recheck the record and verify it with superprojects verify

codes.means: an evidence item has no revision or snapshot, so its historical contents are unknown
codes.fix: add rev or snapshot to the evidence item

codes.means: the file could not be read
codes.fix: restore the file, or remove the folder if the superproject is gone

codes.means: a local evidence source could not be resolved because no record path was supplied
codes.fix: check the record by its path

codes.means: context_version is not 1
codes.fix: set context_version to 1

codes.means: an evidence pin could not be checked against a stable source
codes.fix: supply a revision checker, or pin a committed revision
